Support.title: Technical Support
Support.subtitle: We're here to help you organize your family life better.
Support.intro: At Nawah, we are committed to providing the best experience for your family. If you are experiencing an issue with the app or have a question, please review the information below or contact us directly.
Support.technicalSupportDesc: For technical issues, bug reports, or general inquiries:

Support.q1: How do I invite my family?
Support.a1: Once you create a family, you will see a unique "Join Code" in the Family Settings. Share this code with your family members so they can enter it in the app and join your private group.
Support.a2: Yes. Your family data is encrypted and visible only to the members of the families you join. We do not sell your data and we do not use third-party tracking tools. See our Privacy Policy for more details.
Support.q3: Can I use Nawah for multiple families?
Support.a3: Absolutely. You can create separate families for your immediate household, extended relatives, or even for managing a shared residence.
Support.deletionDesc: To delete your account and all associated data:
Support.deletionStep2: Go to Settings → Account → Delete Account
Support.deletionWarning: Your account and all associated data (profile, family data, chat messages, photos, events, tasks) will be permanently and immediately deleted. This action cannot be undone.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.subtitle: Nawah — Intelligent Family Organization
Privacy.effectiveDate: Effective date: 1 May 2026  ·  Last updated: 1 May 2026
Privacy.introduction:
This Privacy Policy explains how Nawah ("we", "our", or "the app") collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal information when you use the Nawah mobile application. By creating an account or using Nawah, you agree to the practices described below.

Nawah is a family-organization app. Most data you create — chat messages, calendar events, tasks, lists, announcements, polls, vault items, and shared location — is shared with the other members of the families you join. You should treat anything you post inside a family as visible to every member of that family.

s1.title: 1. Introduction
s1.content: This Privacy Policy explains how Nawah collects, uses, and protects your data.

s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
s2.content:
2.1 Information you provide directly

Account information. Your email address, password (stored only as a one-way hash by Firebase Authentication), and display name. A profile photo is optional.

Family content. Chat messages, photos, videos, voice notes, calendar events, tasks, shared lists, polls, announcements, vault items (photos, PDFs, videos, rich-text notes), and any other content you create inside a family.

Voice dictation. Audio you record to dictate messages or requests to the AI Assistant.

Reports and blocks. If you report a message or block another user, we record that action so our moderation team can review it and so blocking can be enforced.

2.2 Information collected automatically

Device information. Operating system, app version, language, and a Firebase Cloud Messaging token used solely to send push notifications you have enabled.

Approximate and precise location. Only when you have enabled the family map feature and granted "When In Use" location permission. Location is shared with your family while the app is open and is not collected in the background.

Authentication metadata. Sign-in timestamps and a Firebase user ID used to associate you with your data.

2.3 Information we do not collect

We do not track you across other apps or websites. The app's privacy manifest declares NSPrivacyTracking = false.

We do not use third-party advertising networks.

We do not use Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, or any third-party analytics or tracking SDKs.

We do not collect your phone number, postal address, contacts, date of birth, gender, or browsing history.

s3.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
s3.content:
To create and authenticate your account.

To deliver the app's core features — sharing content with the families you join, syncing events to your device calendar, displaying your family on the map, and processing your requests to the AI Assistant.

To send you push notifications you have opted in to (chat messages, task assignments, calendar reminders, announcements, polls).

To enforce our Terms of Service, including reviewing reported content and acting on user blocks.

To diagnose technical problems and prevent fraud and abuse.

s4.title: 4. Permissions We Request
table: To take photos and videos to send in chat.
To select existing photos and videos to send in chat.
To record voice notes in chat and dictate messages to the AI assistant.
To transcribe voice dictation into text for the AI assistant.
To show your position to your family on the family map. We do not request background location.
To read your selected device calendar and write Nawah family events into it.
To deliver push alerts you have enabled.

s5.title: 5. How Your Information Is Shared
s5.content:
5.1 With other family members

Content you create inside a family — messages, events, tasks, lists, polls, announcements, vault items, and your live location while the family map is enabled — is visible to every member of that family. Your display name and profile photo are visible to other members so they can identify you in shared content.

5.2 With service providers

We use the following providers to operate the app. Each receives only the data needed to deliver its service:
providers: Google Firebase (Authentication, Firestore, Storage, Cloud Functions, App Check, Cloud Messaging)
Account authentication, primary database, push notifications, abuse prevention.
Your account information, your family content, your device's FCM token.
Object storage for vault files (photos, PDFs, videos).
The file bytes you upload to a family vault. Access is granted via short-lived signed URLs (24-hour maximum).

The request may include the user's prompt, recent AI conversation history, limited account/family context (name, UID, role, active family ID, and member roles), and tool results needed to answer the user's request. Tool results can include relevant events, tasks, shared lists, announcements, or shared locations.
Location coordinates required to render the map view on your device.
s5.footer:
5.3 We do not sell your data

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for advertising or marketing.

5.4 Legal disclosures

We may disclose your information if required by law, valid legal process, or to protect the rights, property, or safety of our users or others. We will resist requests we believe to be overbroad and will notify affected users where legally permitted.

s6.title: 6. Data Storage and Security
s6.content:
Account data and family content are stored in Google Firebase (Firestore and Cloud Storage), encrypted at rest by Google.

Vault file uploads are stored in Cloudflare R2, encrypted at rest.

All network communication uses TLS (HTTPS).

Firebase App Check is used to reduce abuse from unauthorized clients.

We do not implement custom or proprietary cryptography. The app qualifies for the standard U.S. encryption export exemption.

No system is perfectly secure. While we take reasonable measures to protect your information, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

s7.title: 7. Push Notifications
s7.content: We send push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging for events such as new chat messages, task assignments, calendar reminders, announcements, and polls. Notification payloads contain a short title and body (truncated to 120 characters) and the IDs needed to open the right screen. You can disable notifications globally in your device settings or per-category in Settings → Notifications inside the app.

s8.title: 8. Your Choices and Rights
s8.content:
Access and correction. You can view and edit your profile from inside the app at any time.

Account deletion. You can delete your account from More → Settings → Danger Zone → Delete Account. Deletion permanently removes your profile, blocked list, notification preferences, FCM tokens, your shared location, and your family memberships, and deletes your Firebase Authentication record. Messages you sent and items you added to family vaults remain visible to the family but will no longer show your name. Family creators must transfer or delete their families before deleting their account; the app guides you through this.

Reporting and blocking. You can report any chat message via long-press, and you can block any family member at any time. Blocked users can be reviewed and unblocked from Settings → Blocked Users.

Permission control. You can revoke camera, microphone, photo, calendar, location, and notification permissions from your device's system settings at any time. The app will continue to work with reduced functionality.

s9.title: 9. Data Retention
s9.content:
We retain your account information and family content for as long as your account is active. When you delete your account, we delete the items listed in section 8 immediately. Content you contributed to families you have left or to families that continue to exist after your deletion is retained as part of those families' shared history; it is no longer attributed to your account once your user record is removed.

Vault file access URLs expire automatically after 24 hours and are regenerated on demand.

s10.title: 10. International Transfers
s10.content: Our service providers (Google and Cloudflare) operate globally, and your data may be processed in countries other than the one in which you reside, including the United States. Each provider applies its own safeguards for cross-border transfers, including, where applicable, the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses.

s11.title: 11. Children
s11.content: Nawah is intended for use by adults and families together. The app is not directed to children under 13 (or the equivalent minimum age in your jurisdiction), and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under that age. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information without parental consent, please contact us at the address below and we will delete it.

s12.title: 12. Changes to This Policy
s12.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we make material changes we will update the "Last updated" date above and, where appropriate, notify you in the app. Continued use of Nawah after a change constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

s13.title: 13. Contact Us
s13.content:
If you have questions, concerns, or requests about this Privacy Policy or your data, contact us at:

Email: privacy@nawahfamily.com
